adaptation: Standard layout adapted: the chart anchors on total money in (revenue $173.8M + non-cash warrant fair-value gain $896.2M = $1,070.0M) because IonQ's costs alone are 3.5x revenue and the warrant gain is 5.2x revenue — a revenue-scaled chart cannot draw either. Other expense, net ($59.2M) is grouped with operating expenses, so the chart's operating line plus interest, net, equals reported pre-tax income. Balance checks on the adapted model: total money in = left after direct costs + cost of revenue ($1,070.0M = $934.2M + $135.8M); left after direct costs = adapted operating result + operating expenses ($934.2M = $403.9M + $530.3M); adapted operating result + other income - tax = net income ($403.9M + $17.5M + $141.7M tax benefit = $563.1M). Reported figures are unchanged: revenue $173.8M, operating loss -$433.1M, net income $563.1M.
verdict: IonQ's revenue jumped 336% to $174M on quantum computer deployments and its new SkyWater foundry business — and while operations lost $433M, a $896M non-cash warrant gain produced a $564M GAAP profit.

segments.name: IonQ Platform
segments.note: Quantum computers, networking, sensing and security — including global deployments of Tempo systems. Up 127% YoY (all of last year's revenue was this segment).

segments.name: SkyWater Foundry Services
segments.note: Chip foundry services from SkyWater, acquired in the quarter — $53.8M of CMOS foundry work and $29.8M of quantum foundry and advanced technologies. A brand-new segment.

segments.name: Warrant fair-value gain
segments.note: A paper gain: IonQ's warrant liabilities fell in value as its share price moved, so accounting rules book a gain. No cash arrived, and it reverses if the share price rises. Shown as a source because it is what turned a big operating loss into a GAAP profit.

opex.name: General & administrative
opex.note: Running the company — the biggest running cost this quarter, up 86% YoY as IonQ absorbed acquisitions.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Building quantum computers, networking, sensing and security products. More than doubled YoY.

opex.name: Depreciation & amortization
opex.note: Spreading the cost of equipment and acquired technology over their lives — up more than 5x YoY after the SkyWater deal.

opex.name: Other expense, net
opex.note: Other expense IonQ reports below its operating result — grouped with operating expenses in this adapted layout so the operating line ties to reported pre-tax income.

opex.name: Sales & marketing
opex.note: Selling quantum systems and services. More than tripled YoY.

otherDetail: Interest income, net, of $19.8M less $2.3M of interest expense, net +$17.5M. The $59.2M of other expense is grouped with operating expenses in this adapted layout, and the $896.2M warrant gain is shown as a source at the left of the chart.
follow100Note: Adapted for IonQ: this table is per $100 of total money in (revenue + the warrant gain), not per $100 of revenue — per $100 of revenue alone, the warrant gain would be about $516 and costs about $349, and the table would be meaningless.
footerNote: Adapted layout — see one-time items. Figures in $M to three decimals so the lines add up exactly. Reported operating result was a $433M loss.

takeaways.title: Revenue quadrupled, backlog doubled
takeaways.text: Revenue rose 336% to $173.8M — IonQ Platform up 127% to $90.3M on Tempo deployments, plus $83.5M from the newly acquired SkyWater foundry. Remaining performance obligations more than doubled to $1.2B, and full-year revenue guidance was raised to $505-515M.

takeaways.title: Operations are still deeply loss-making
takeaways.text: The reported operating loss was $433M: total operating costs of $607M against $174M of revenue, including $149M of stock pay and $128M of depreciation and amortization. On the company's own adjusted basis, the EBITDA loss was $134M.

takeaways.title: A paper gain made the profit
takeaways.text: Net income was $563M only because warrant liabilities fell in value by $896M — a non-cash accounting gain — plus a $142M tax benefit. A year ago the same warrant line was an $882M loss. Cash, equivalents and investments were $1.7B at quarter end, $3.7B pro forma for October's equity raise.

oneTimers: Gain on change in fair value of warrant liabilities: +$896.2M — a non-cash paper gain (the warrants IonQ owes became cheaper as the share price moved). It is shown as a source in the chart, with the layout adapted and documented, because it is 5.2x revenue.
Income tax was a $141.7M benefit this quarter, mostly deferred — it added to the bottom line instead of reducing it.

Stock-based compensation was $148.6M in the quarter, and the SkyWater acquisition closed in the quarter, adding a whole foundry segment (and its costs) that was not there a year ago. Elisity was acquired on November 3, after quarter end, for about $1.3B.
